name: Abhitesh Shukla
subtitle: Robotics · Control Systems · Computer Vision
focus: intelligent machines · high-resolution vision · reproducible experiments

projects.title: TRACTION-AWARE AMR
summary: A virtual warehouse rover with friction-limited dynamics,
linear and nonlinear tracking, and traction supervision.
ROS 2 integration, a Pico carrier PCB, and reproducible tests.

projects.title: SATELLITE TILE SEGMENTATION
summary: Pixel-wise segmentation of high-resolution aerial imagery
with a residual U-Net and a dilated bottleneck.
Patch extraction, test-time augmentation, and tile reconstruction.

projects.title: VQ-VAE PATHOLOGY TRIAGE
summary: A preprocessing gate for gigapixel pathology imagery.
Memory-mapped tiling and VQ-VAE reconstruction error
screen patches before expensive downstream segmentation.
